ai_summary: APAR Industries Limited reported robust Q1 FY2026-27 consolidated financial results, with revenue growing 29.1% and profit after tax surging 77.8% year-over-year. The company is strategically expanding internationally through the incorporation of a UK subsidiary and further investment in its Brazilian operations. A potential red flag is the Power/Telecom cables segment, which experienced a 37% decline in segment results despite healthy revenue growth, indicating significant margin compression or cost challenges within that division.
